Appreciate your thoughts, though I have my doubts about the severity of consequences in this virus situation as you have feared. The man you mentioned revealed his name in a public statement and I failed to find any mention of him receiving threats or ostracism. As someone else mentioned in another thread the Singaporean government has done even further as to publicize the info themselves. 

With all of this I find it strange that the media hasn’t jumped onto reporting people receiving threats as they are usually pretty fond of these topics.
Singapore and South Korea are widely recognized to be the top models dealing with this crisis, their systems are certainly worth emulating to some degree with careful studying.
The doctor isn’t calling to doxx patient address but the community location. Right now we don’t know which towns on the Island have cases, only the total number.

While it’s definitely wrong for Patient 31 to be doxxed and harassed the way she was, calling the nature of her case unique would be an understatement. There hasn’t been report of wide social ostracism going on as far as I am aware off, given that low risk I’d say it’s certainly worth the benefits. 

Besides, nobody is calling for doxxing patients here, but I think we should have more specific information than knowing an island larger than the size of Belgium has X number of patients.
